debug.description: Enable verbose debug output for brctl commands

stp_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for STP convergence on bridge ports (4–30 recommended)

stp_auto.description: Enable STP automatically for new bridges (if true, STP is on by default)

forward_delay.description: STP forward delay in seconds (time spent in listening/learning states)

hello_time.description: STP hello time in seconds (interval between BPDU packets)

max_age.description: STP max age in seconds (how long BPDU info is considered valid)

bridge_priority.description: Bridge priority for STP root election (lower = more likely to be root)

stp_enabled.description: Enable STP globally (requires kernel bridge module support)

bridge_prefix.description: Prefix for automatically named bridge interfaces (e.g., 'br' → br0, br1)

kernel_module_options.description: Additional options passed to the bridge kernel module (e.g., ['max_hash=4096'])

bridges.description: List of bridge interfaces to configure or manage

stp.description: Enable STP for this specific bridge

create.description: Create this bridge if it does not exist (during init)
